description: This file implements chunking metadata propagation rules for a PyTorch FX graph transformation pass, including functions for registering rules, propagating metadata forward and backward through various tensor operations, and handling specific node types like addmm, mm, sum, permute, expand, etc. It is part of an auto-chunking system to optimize tensor computations.

classes.name: PropagateStatus
classes.description: Enum representing the status of chunking metadata propagation: success with no change, success with change, or failure.

methods.name: _register_propagate_rule
methods.description: Registers a propagation rule for specific torch operations, wrapping the handler to manage propagation status.

methods.name: register_propagate_rule
methods.description: Partial function to register a propagation rule for given torch operations.

methods.name: _is_success
methods.description: Checks if all provided statuses indicate successful propagation (no failure).

methods.name: _enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues a node into a queue with debug logging.

methods.name: can_reach_amplified_node
methods.description: Determines reachability of nodes with the same number of elements as an amplifier node, used for propagation analysis.

methods.name: propagate
methods.description: Main function to propagate chunking metadata starting from an amplifier node.

methods.name: propagate_single_node
methods.description: Propagates chunking metadata through a single node, following registered rules.

methods.name: _bool_to_status
methods.description: Converts a boolean indicating change into a PropagateStatus.

methods.name: propagate_addmm
methods.description: Propagation rule for aten.addmm, handling chunking metadata for bias, input, and weight nodes.

methods.name: propagate_mm
methods.description: Propagation rule for aten.mm, handling chunking metadata for matrix multiplication.

methods.name: propagate_general_copy_metadata
methods.description: General rule to copy chunking metadata across various tensor operations, with optional broadcast handling.

methods.name: propagate_general_copy_metadata_ignore_broadcast
methods.description: Same as above but ignoring broadcast considerations.

methods.name: propagate_reduce
methods.description: Propagation rule for reduction operations like sum and max.

methods.name: propagate_permute
methods.description: Propagation rule for tensor permute operation, adjusting chunking metadata accordingly.

methods.name: propagate_expand
methods.description: Propagation rule for aten.expand, propagating chunking metadata if the input is a singleton.

methods.name: propagate_sum_to_scalar
methods.description: Propagation rule for sum operations reducing to a scalar, updating chunking metadata accordingly.
